Real controlled-mailbox invitation, opaque 32-byte random secret encoded unpadded base64url (43 characters), 24h expiry, initial password under existing policy; no operator-chosen password or verified flag. STAFF_INV format2/AAD cannot decrypt as SYSTEM INVITATION or Customer; old format1 fixtures unchanged; revoked/expired/cancelled eligibility fails claim/open/send; bounded retry and crash lease recovery; post-provider-acceptance crash may redeliver same invitation, never activates account; no tokens/password/verifiers/email in logs/errors/reports/CLI receipts; outbox erasure on terminal state.

TLS/Origin/CSRF/cookie flags, unknown/duplicate fields, oversize input, rate limits, wrong realm/audience across all endpoints, preauth/session CSRF binding, refresh rotation/replay, idle/absolute/access expiry, disabled account/authVersion, wrong purpose and captured/reentrant context denial; no SYSTEM admin or Customer/Merchant access from Staff tokens. Exact Staff filter matchers precede Customer chain; Organization Staff mutation rejects Customer CSRF/cookies/context and vice versa; unknown protected subpaths never fall through to another principal audience.

Same request same input and lost response one grant/audit/receipt; changed input/operator/database/environment reject; concurrent same/different keys; existing ACTIVE no-change; revoke absent no-change; replay GRANT after revoke returns current REVOKED without regrant; fresh authorized regrant new ID, old bindings invalid; no grant or audit without matching receipt and rollback injection at every write.

Canonical grants alone denied; exact Organization binding plus current grant required; other Org/no binding/wrong case assignee denied; TRIAGE cannot HANDLE without HANDLE and case assignment, HANDLE cannot TRIAGE; disabled Staff/revoked grant/binding/Organization immediately denied, including receipt replay; Merchant branch and Personal Support unchanged. Merchant creator/internal assignee still receives notices after Staff reply/transition using current Customer reference eligibility, preference and Organization permission; referenced Customer cannot become handler or authenticated Staff; replay emits no duplicate notice.

Production/unknown profile, wrong environment, disabled sentinel, database name/OID/system-ID mismatch, copied DB with unmatched identity, missing config/key or unavailable checker fails closed. No automatic local operator membership. SYSTEM INACTIVE and 3 existing accounts unchanged; NamShop 5 Merchant grants unchanged.

Dedicated Staff invitation fragment consumed in memory with immediate history scrub; password creation then Staff login; no secrets in query/localStorage/referrer; existing Organization Support desk uses Staff client and auth audience, no Personal workspace switch or admin menu. No binding -> 403 clean UX; test-only binding permits exact existing desk workflow. Frontend typecheck/lint/build and affected Browser tests only.

Identity API-only cross-domain admission, Orders owns Support grant storage, workflow coordinates existing Ticket APIs; required architecture/report-policy plus affected Customer enrollment/session, SYSTEM invitation format1, Team and Personal Support focused regressions. Full-suite/CI evidence only if actually run on exact implementation revision.

owner_decisions.decision: Approve exact STAFF/SUPPORT purpose and 24h invitation policy, 6 new HTTP operations/13 DTOs and 6 existing Organization Staff admission-only changes, typed admission and the bounded existing Support Staff adapter change; no Customer conversion or SYSTEM activation.

Approve 4 justified tables, additive purpose/audience/constraint amendments, 3 non-login DB roles and exact restricted functions/privileges; environment starts disabled and no live operator login receives authority automatically.

Approve canonical request-bound signature, permanent receipts/current-authority replay, deny-only legacy path and target-eligibility amendment to existing V35 binding function; no automatic Organization binding.

Approve V36/V37 numbers only if still free at implementation preflight and focused isolated PostgreSQL18/HTTP/security/Browser tests. Any collision or changed API/schema/privilege requires reporting exact delta; do not rewrite accepted manifest or migration silently. Local deployment/provision/grants/feature activation remain separate checkpoints.

risks: Shared SYSTEM session tables need exhaustive audience predicates in every store/browser/timing/query; a single omitted lookup is a security defect. Required negative tests block release; Customer tables are not broadened.
Forward-only V5/ADR-0010 amendment adds an explicit purpose branch, never relaxes the old realm policy. Existing format1 ciphertext must remain verifiable until expiry.

Physical DB binding prevents accidental copied-database activation when identity differs; a deliberate clone preserving physical identity and operator roles is outside automatic detection. Runtime Production guard and controlled deployment approval remain independently mandatory.

DB constraints/ACLs protect direct DML and transaction consistency; HMAC possession and password policy remain a trusted Identity application responsibility. SQL activation is not claimed to cryptographically authenticate an arbitrary malicious holder of runtime DB credentials. No token/password/key is sent to offline operator or audit.

NOLOGIN writer roles/functions require exact deployment privileges. If migration principal cannot safely create them or restrict pg_control_system privilege, stop and report; no schema-owner DML fallback.
Current source includes uncommitted Team/Support dependencies and V34/V35; this design is not evidence that they are merged or CI-green. Preserve WIP; no commit/push/merge authorized.
SMTP provider acceptance is not proof of inbox delivery. Live controlled mailbox verification belongs to the later approved provisioning checkpoint, not this design review.
No completed runtime tests, full PostgreSQL PASS, GitHub CI PASS or Local Staff authority is implied by this manifest.

guards.triggers: BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE principal, BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE marked user_account; BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE customer_identifier/account_grant; DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED AFTER principal/operator receipt/proof/account/outbox Staff changes checks complete correlation. Exclusion also checks username/email uniqueness under administration lock. Trigger functions not publicly callable; Staff writes only under controlled writer; Customer/SYSTEM behavior unchanged. BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE membership account_id uses identity.support_staff_registered; Staff cannot become Merchant, existing members unaffected. Identity marker creation symmetrically rejects any existing membership, including terminal records. No Merchant grant or Role modification.

Add BEFORE grant/audit/new-receipt provenance/append-only checks without replacing existing immutable grant guard; DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED AFTER changed grant/new audit/new receipt requires exact mutual request/target/permission/version/operator evidence. Runtime raw canonical grants denied; old audits remain immutable and valid.
